title: Trump picks longtime aide Will Scharf as new top White House lawyer
description: The White House staff secretary replaces David Warrington, who is leaving for the private sector.

title: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez says she’s freezing her eggs
description: The Democratic congresswoman, 36, said she made the decision to undergo the fertility procedure to “feel more in control of my life.”

title: After bitter primary, El-Sayed faces daunting task of unifying Democrats
description: Before going up against Republican Mike Rogers in November, Abdul El-Sayed must heal the wounds from his fierce race against Rep. Haley Stevens.

title: Window closes for Ohio GOP to replace Rep. Max Miller on the ballot
description: The Republican congressman, who denies claims of domestic abuse, has resisted growing calls to drop his bid for a third term.

title: Group urges Democrats to woo moderate voters with populist policies
description: A progressive group says messages that target the wealthy and large corporations appeal to a majority of Americans who see the economy as fundamentally rigged.

title: Max Miller is refusing to drop his bid for reelection. Here's what voters think
description: Voters in Ohio's 7th Congressional district react to calls for Rep. Max Miller to drop his bid for reelection. He ran uncontested in the May 5 GOP primary. The Democratic nominee is Brian Poindexter.

title: Blanche as AG faces pressure from Trump, skeptical courts, low staff morale
description: As Todd Blanche officially takes over at the helm, the challenges for the Justice Department have been stacking up.

title: Haunted by Hoover, Trump searches for an endgame in Iran
description: President Trump is confronting a question that has haunted presidents throughout history: how a war - that has gone on longer than predicted - can reshape a presidency.

title: Politics chat: Progressive candidates in primaries, Trump's influence on midterms
description: Republicans are trying to hang fringe positions on Democrats but may not be able to withstand the economic headwinds in November's midterms.

title: Montana's Democratic candidate is facing pressure to drop out by the deadline
description: Monday, Aug. 10, is the deadline to remove names from Montana's ballot. The Democrat in the Senate race there is being pressured to drop out to clear the field for an independent.

title: There's a birth control backlash online. Can it explain the rise in abortions?
description: The number of abortions is up in the United States. Is it because fewer people are using birth control pills?

title: Joe Biden’s cancer has spread, Hunter Biden says
description: In a BBC interview, Hunter Biden also acknowledged that the pardon he received from his father was “not fair” or good for the country.

title: GOP-controlled Senate delivers win for Trump with Blanche confirmation
description: The Senate narrowly confirmed former Trump personal attorney Todd Blanche as U.S. Attorney General, a major win for the president's approach to keeping the Justice Department close to the White House.

title: Senate narrowly approves Todd Blanche as AG, capping tough confirmation fight
description: The early-morning 50-49 vote grants President Donald Trump’s former criminal defense lawyer a full stint as the head of the Justice Department, which has been rocked by vacancies and controversies.

title: Pirro, Trump’s longtime champion, is on the outs over Reflecting Pool move
description: D.C.’s top prosecutor spent a year navigating the president’s demands. Now she finds her job at risk amid a rare break with him over cases of alleged vandalism.

title: Voter turnout surges in Tennessee after Black-majority district is erased
description: High Democratic turnout for House primaries in Shelby County, which includes Memphis, is the latest sign that redistricting may be energizing Black Southern voters.

title: Longtime San Francisco nonprofit will close as city gets tougher on crime
description: The demise of SF Pretrial, which for 50 years has provided diversion services, came after the mayor cut its budget and as Democrats’ attitudes toward crime shift.

title: Democratic voters who used to back Susan Collins aren’t so sure anymore
description: Sen. Susan Collins (R-Maine) has counted on split-ticket voters to help her win office in a blue state. Some of those supporters are more reluctant to vote for her again.

title: Minnesota GOP divided over Mike Lindell's potential gubernatorial nomination
description: Mike Lindell of "MyPillow" fame, might win the GOP primary for Minnesota governor running on a Trump platform. Other Republicans are concerned that his closeness could hurt his chances in November.

title: Legal scholar Lawrence Lessig on how a Maine law could topple Super PACs
description: NPR's Scott Simon speaks with legal scholar and activist Lawrence Lessig about the influence of outside money in elections and a court challenge to a Maine state law capping donations to Super PACs.

title: Week in Politics: Blanche confirmed as attorney general; Iran-Oman Strait deal stalls
description: We look at what it took to get Todd Blanche confirmed as U.S. attorney general, as well as the proposed deal between Iran and Oman to control the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Private prisons announce $1.4 billion in revenue as immigration detentions climb
description: That revenue does not include net proceeds of $1.6 billion made by CoreCivic after the recent sale of four of their facilities to the Department of Homeland Security.
